meta.title: GATBOX: EPROM families for the dashboard's DUMP picker
meta.note: Families only. The exact part names are always minipro's own (minipro -q T48 -l, generated at install into /usr/local/share/gatbox/minipro-parts-T48.txt): a family tile lists every T48 part whose name contains one of its search terms, and the owner picks the one printed on the chip. minipro's chip-ID check names the right one when a pick is wrong. A name without '@' is minipro's default package (DIP), e.g. M27C801. Every search term here matched DIP parts on 2026-09-28 (tests/test-dump.py checks it against the installed list).
meta.size_note: Sizes follow the part numbers' own convention (27C010 = 1 Mbit); DIP40/DIP42 parts are 16-bit wide and fit the T48's socket directly.
meta.bytes_note: bytes: a whole-chip dump's size (what MAME lists for a ROM), so a chip from the MAME checklist points at its family tiles. The 27C160 / 27C800 tile covers both sizes.
